_instructions: Edit this file to correct the treasure tile positions in Game_Board_Ref.png.
Each entry covers one tile position (row 0-5, col 0-6).
FIELDS:
row / col   : 0-indexed position in the image grid
shape       : 'corner' | 'straight' | 't-junction'
treasure_id : treasure ID from the list below, or null for blank tiles
skip        : true = fixed home corner tile — never used for matching, leave as-is
note        : free-text reminder, not used by the app
TREASURE IDs (movable tiles only — the ones that appear on the game board):
Corner-shaped treasures : lizard, moth, owl, scarab, rat, spider
T-junction treasures    : bat, dragon, ghost_bottle, ghost_waving, lady_pig, sorceress
FIXED-TILE TREASURES (shown in atlas for visual reference only, always pre-placed):
book, coins, map, crown, keys, skull, ring, chest, emerald, sword, menorah, helmet
→ For tiles showing these icons, set treasure_id to null (they are just blank tiles).
SPARE TILE:
Listed separately at the bottom under 'spare'.
IMAGE GEOMETRY (used to auto-calculate pixel bounds — edit if your image differs):
tile_size : pixel width/height of each tile
gap       : pixel gap between tiles
margin_x  : left edge offset
margin_y  : top edge offset
